en.short_description: House listings, sales and rentals via public real-estate APIs
en.subtitle: What house can I afford?
en.description:
HomeWise answers one question properly: what can you actually afford, and what will it cost you every month?

AFFORDABILITY
Enter your household income, the cash you have, and your existing debt. HomeWise applies front-end and back-end debt-to-income limits and tells you the price range those limits put you in — and which limit is the one binding you.

PAYMENT
Break a monthly payment into principal, interest, taxes, insurance, and the costs that scale with price, so you can see what is loan and what is everything else.

SCHEDULE
The full amortization schedule, payment by payment, with the crossover month where you start paying more principal than interest.

COMPARE
Save scenarios and put them side by side. Different price, different rate, different down payment — the same maths on all of them.

ASSUMPTIONS YOU CONTROL
Rates, tax rates, insurance, and the DTI limits are all yours to change, and HomeWise shows you the assumption behind every number instead of hiding it. It is a calculator, not a lender: it does not pull your credit, does not talk to a bank, and does not need an account.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
HomeWise answers one question properly: what can you actually afford, and what will it cost you every month?

Intended audience:
What house can I afford?

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
None. The app works entirely on the device and calls no external service.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
